fact: In 2023 regulated financial providers received 52,082 consumer complaints (14,340 in 2022), of which 52,041 (99.92%) were resolved, with payment institutions accounting for 98.41% of complaints received.
title: Rapport d'enquête sur l'offre des produits et services financiers formels au Burundi, exercice 2023
publisher: Banque de la République du Burundi
